attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 21 Μαΐου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. He is none of the corpus's men of this name: not `cyril-of-the-white-lake`, not `cyril-of-kazan`, not `cyril-of-alexandria`. The page gives 1231 to 1262 for the episcopate and 1262 for the death, and the `dates` object carries the death alone. Prince Peter Ordynsk, whom his preaching brought to baptism, has no folder, so he is named without a link — the corpus's `peter-of-murom` is another man. No hymn.
